author: jchismar
body:
#### PR description:

In line with #51817, this PR removes the `trackCutClassifier` procModifier that disables the HLT track purity DNN. The procModifier is unneeded at this stage, and can easily be reintroduced if needed in the future.

Additionally, the cut classifier is removed from `hltInitialStepHPSelectionSequence` after the DNN, and the DNN is updated to allow for three working points (loose, tight, HP). The working points are currently all set to the same value of 99.5% efficiency (the current DNN threshold). This change has no effect on physics performance (see [comparison validation plots here](http://uaf-2.t2.ucsd.edu/~jachisma/track-purity-dnn/20_1_0_pre3/w-wo-cuts/plots_hlt.html)), as there is a passThroughForAll flag used in the current cut classifier.  

FYI @mmasciov @bdanzi
title: Remove trackCutClassifer procModifier and enable working points for HLT track purity DNN
